description.value:
Trigger A creature moves into your reach.

Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike does not trigger reactions the target would otherwise be able to use in response to it.

cinderfall.incomplete: This is Waywarden's own Reactive-Strike-shaped homebrew reaction. P9 (Reactive Strike) confirms that even the real system's own version of "Strike a creature that moves within your reach" is hardcoded system trigger logic tied to one specific compendium action, not a reproducible generic rule-element hook. This hands the actor a wholly new usable action/reaction. Confirmed absent per two direct spot checks: Fighter's Double Slice only rule-encodes its minor non-agile penalty -- the actual "resolve two Strikes as one attack, combine damage" behavior is hardcoded PF2e system logic. Fighter's Reactive Strike is granted via a bare GrantItem whose trigger is likewise hardcoded system behavior tied to one specific compendium action UUID, not a generic rule-element hook. Any Waywarden card proposing an equivalent bespoke Strike-triggering or multi-Strike-resolving action inherits the same gap.
